titolo: How Knight Capital Lost $440 Million in 45 Minutes

copertina.immagine: glossy 3D red falling stock arrow shattering a glass skyscraper, dramatic dark background

shots.voce: Four hundred forty million dollars. Gone in forty-five minutes.
August first, twenty twelve. A normal morning on Wall Street.
Knight Capital was one of the biggest traders in America.
A new trading program had been installed overnight.
But one server was never updated. Old code woke up.
shots.immagine: single glowing red server rack among dark identical server racks, faceless technician figure beside it

shots.voce: Nine thirty. The market opens. Something is very wrong.
The software began buying and selling stocks nonstop, at wild prices.
Millions of unwanted orders flooded the market.
Nobody could find the off switch fast enough.
Every minute, the losses grew by millions.
Forty-five minutes later, the machine was finally stopped.
The company's entire value was erased. It needed a rescue.
shots.immagine: cracked golden piggy bank with coins spilling out, faceless hands reaching to catch them

shots.voce: Within months, Knight Capital was sold.
The twist? One forgotten server, one missing update. That's all.
